verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a SaaS experimentation platform, but the evidence never shows one inside the Statsig console. The MCP server exposes Statsig to external AI clients such as Cursor and Claude Code, which is not an in-product assistant. AI Evals and the OpenAI integration are tools for experimenting on customers' own AI apps, not an assistant users can delegate tasks to.
